quarterly_data.quarter: Dell press release: Dell Technologies Turns Enterprise Data Into Trusted (10-06-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Dell expanded the Dell AI Data Platform (the data foundation of the Dell AI Factory) with a Unified Semantic Layer, an Enterprise Knowledge Graph and Knowledge Agents, to be released in 1H 2027, using NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever models and enabling NVIDIA Auto-Ontology. Dell PowerScale now supports up to 500 tenants in a single cluster, with mTLS over NFS and more granular role-based access control; these security and multitenancy enhancements will be available in November 2026. Dell Data Processing Engine enhancements with the NVIDIA acceleration stack (NVIDIA cuDF on NVIDIA RTX PRO 4500 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs) will be available in December 2026, with further acceleration using Apache Arrow expected 1H 2027; in Dell internal testing in September 2026 on a Dell PowerEdge R770 the engine processed data nearly 4 times faster on average than CPUs alone and up to 20 times faster on batch processing workloads (3.9x average and 20.4x peak speedup). The Dell Storage Performance Tool for S3-compatible object storage and AI-ready data services are available now. Arthur Lewis, president, Infrastructure Solutions Group: 'Data without context is just noise.'
quarterly_data.figure: PowerScale up to 500 tenants per cluster (November 2026); Data Processing Engine 3.9x average / 20.4x peak speedup in Dell internal testing (December 2026); semantic layer, knowledge graph and agents in 1H 2027
